context:
Goal: a false "pre-existing, on main at <hash>" claim never passes the report check.
Problem (risk): a line "on origin/<the PR's own branch> at <PR head>" passes, because the head is on that branch, so a lane can name its own branch as the base.
Based on (read): lint/report_guard.py `_check_run_hash`; a test pins the pass; note pe-own-branch-base-passes in docs/debts/notes.md calls it harmless, unmeasured.
Departs from: main passes the PR's own branch as a base — b refuses it.
home: step base-hash-on-base (a pre-existing claim names a hash on the base)

options.gain: No new false alarms; #2892 merges now.
options.how: The pass stays a filed note until a real incident.
options.label: Keep it as a note (Recommended)
options.lose: A lane's own branch name clears a false claim.

options.how: The check refuses a base ref that is the PR's own branch.
options.label: Refuse the PR's own branch
options.lose: One more build and review round on #2892; a wrong guess at "own branch" could refuse a true claim.

short: Own branch as base: note or refuse
title: A report naming its own branch as the base for a pre-existing claim
why: Closing it widens what the report check refuses.
